resources.name: DFT code with GGA-PW91 (e.g., GPAW, Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP)

access.notes: Any standard DFT code implementing GGA‑PW91 and spin‑polarized calculations is acceptable. Open‑source options include GPAW (pip install gpaw) or Quantum ESPRESSO; VASP may be used if the solver has a license.

resources.notes: The TB‑LMTO‑ASA code used in the original paper is not required; any DFT package producing comparable energies and moments for the same geometry suffices.
